pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Let me tell you something, Bubba G, nobody drafts teams to fight each other like they're staging a civil war except you, with this France versus Morocco showdown proving you're the master of drafting chaos.** Look at me, Gunner! What was going through your head when you picked both France and Morocco? Did you think a mystical force would unite them against your other hapless foes? France is burning hot with top-flight form, while Morocco has shown gritty surprises, but this scheduling face-off screams one thing: you’re splitting your own squad in half like a piñata at a kid's party. You’re lucky France usually has a knack for elegance and style, giving you a solid chance for points. I’m predicting a French win not because of your expert drafting, but because it's as obvious as the USA's jersey colors. Zach, you're still just Mustard Boy stuck in third place mediocrity despite Switzerland's timely penalty win; it's like giving a chef's kiss to ketchup on hot dogs. Rafe, "The Noisemaker", you should keep playing the chaos card and get your fantasy soccer issues sorted by your sweet sixteen — you can’t ride on the flapping wings of the Eagle of Uzbekistan forever. And Gayden, "The Backpass Assassin," 4th place is just the beginning of a slippery slope—after all, being an assassin with no upsets is like taking a Nerf gun to a sword fight. Gunner, your first-place standing may be barely adequate, but let’s face it: you’ll always have a shadow of doubt when your teams play against themselves and hand out points like candy. Mic drop.
